        <value>(function(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_146833_claudec_0_request');
    gr.addQuery('session_id', 'atf_chat_e2e_test');
    gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    gr.setLimit(1);
    gr.query();

    if (!gr.next()) {
        assertEqual({ name: 'Staging record exists', shouldbe: 'found', value: 'not_found' });
        return;
    }

    var status       = gr.getValue('status') || '';
    var model        = gr.getValue('model') || '';
    var inputTokens  = parseInt(gr.getValue('input_tokens'), 10) || 0;
    var outputTokens = parseInt(gr.getValue('output_tokens'), 10) || 0;
    var durationMs   = parseInt(gr.getValue('duration_ms'), 10) || 0;
    var prompt       = gr.getValue('prompt') || '';
    var responseText = gr.getValue('response_text') || '';

    assertEqual({ name: 'Status is success',        shouldbe: 'success', value: status });
    assertEqual({ name: 'Model is populated',        shouldbe: true,      value: model.length > 0 });
    assertEqual({ name: 'Input tokens > 0',          shouldbe: true,      value: inputTokens > 0 });
    assertEqual({ name: 'Output tokens > 0',         shouldbe: true,      value: outputTokens > 0 });
    assertEqual({ name: 'Duration recorded',         shouldbe: true,      value: durationMs > 0 });
    assertEqual({ name: 'Prompt was captured',       shouldbe: true,      value: prompt.length > 0 });
    assertEqual({ name: 'Response text was captured', shouldbe: true,     value: responseText.length > 0 });

    stepResult.setOutputMessage(
        'Staging record verified: status=' + status +
        ', model=' + model +
        ', in_tokens=' + inputTokens +
        ', out_tokens=' + outputTokens +
        ', duration_ms=' + durationMs
    );
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);</value>
